assign.outcome:
**38 pages measured, 3390 findings, before round done.** 13 `/imagine/` realms (landing + first two children each; `generated/` has only one real child so got landing+1) across 400/1280/1920/2560/3440. Reusable script: `spacing-audit-b.mjs` (one browser/context, resizes between widths). `findings.json`, shot set and ten crops all in this task dir. Dominant pattern: 29 of 31 pages with a measurable median grow **< 1.3x** from 1280→3440 while the viewport grows 2.69x (median growth 1.20x) — spacing across `/imagine/` barely reacts to screen width, matching the owner's complaint directly. Worst single finding: `a.decks-chip` in `/imagine/decks/half/` and `/imagine/decks/golden/` is 8.6-14.4x wider than its own text at every width above 1280 — a real instance of the owner's 'massive strip of empty' toolbar-button pattern. Caught and fixed my own measurement bug mid-run: a `

` with inline ``/`` children was read as vertically-stacked boxes, manufacturing huge fake gaps from ordinary text wrapping — re-ran clean after excluding `display: inline` children from the sibling-row scan (ratio findings dropped from a noisy 231 to a trustworthy 21, 19 of which the script itself could attribute to a heading or `

` boundary).
